policy: These are primary-provider operational candidates only. They are not production verified until matched to the live Nevada HCQC/ALiS Las Vegas Valley PCA registry by exact license or strong contact identity.

records.agency_name: SENIORS HELPING SENIORS LAS VEGAS SOUTH
records.evidence_summary: Primary Las Vegas South site prints Nevada license 11765-PCS-0 and the 9646 Bella Citta St location; it lists bathing/showering, dressing, mobility assistance, meals, housekeeping and medication reminders. Caregiver hiring page states background checks and competency exams.

records.agency_name: LAS VEGAS FAMILY HOME CARE LLC
records.evidence_summary: Primary provider site prints Nevada license 9599-PCS-3 and states that it provides individualized daily-living assistance for aging, illness, recovery and rehabilitation. Specific ADL fields remain UNKNOWN until directly evidenced.

Primary Home Instead Las Vegas site identifies 1210 S Valley View Blvd Suite 206 and 702-796-6393. It states Care Pros are employees rather than contractors, background checked, covered by liability insurance and workers' compensation, with qualified backup coverage; local service pages describe shower support, mobility, medication reminders, meals, housekeeping and post-hospital recovery care.

Primary Henderson site identifies 2560 Anthem Village Drive Ste 110, 702-551-5505 and service coverage including Henderson, Boulder City and Las Vegas. It states caregivers are screened, trained and insured.

records.agency_name: BRIGHTSTAR CARE OF LAS VEGAS WEST
records.evidence_summary: BrightStar Care Las Vegas primary/local sources identify 4775 S Durango Dr Suite 200 and 702-982-2273. BrightStar personal-care materials list bathing, dressing/grooming, mobility, hygiene, meals, housekeeping, medication reminders and outpatient pre/post-op support, with nurse-guided care and 24/7 local availability.

Nevada Senior Services primary site identifies its In-Home Services program at 901 N Jones Blvd with 702-333-1599. The PCS page explicitly lists bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, mobility/safe transfers, meals, housekeeping, laundry and medication reminders. A careers page lists In-Home PCA work across Las Vegas, North Las Vegas and Henderson; Spanish is only a hiring preference signal, not verified client-language availability.

FreedomCare Nevada primary site identifies 4245 S Grand Canyon Dr Suite 216 and 602-834-9150, states it is a licensed PCS provider serving Nevada, and lists bathing/dressing/grooming, toileting, transferring, mobility, housekeeping, laundry, shopping and meal preparation. The offering is strongly Medicaid/family-caregiver oriented and should not be assumed to fit private-pay short visits.
